meta.title: KickStake
meta.description: Create a football tournament sweepstake, share a link, and let KickStake run the draw and the prizes for you.

hero.subtitle: Spin up a tournament sweepstake, drop one link in the group chat, and KickStake runs the random draw, splits the prize pot, tracks who's paid, and settles up at the end.
hero.microcopy: Free to start · players join with no account · ~60 seconds to set up

trust.tracking: 🔒 Tracking-only — we never touch your money

oldWay.title: The end of sweepstake admin
oldWay.sub: If you've ever organised one, you know the pain. KickStake does the boring, argument-starting parts for you.
old: Draw team names out of an actual hat
Work out the prize splits by hand
Chase everyone in the chat for the buy-in
Argue about who won which prize
new: Prize pot auto-built, balanced to the cent
One-tap draw — seeded and provably fair
Paid tracking + a clean settlement summary
Everyone sees their teams & live winnings

how.title: From idea to kickoff in four steps

steps.title: Create
steps.desc: Pick the tournament, set the buy-in. KickStake auto-builds a 12-prize pot you can tweak.

steps.title: Share
steps.desc: Send one link to the group chat. Everyone joins with just a name — no account.

steps.title: Draw
steps.desc: Hit Run Draw. All 48 teams are assigned fairly and locked, with a stored seed.

steps.title: Settle
steps.desc: Approve the auto-suggested winners. See live winnings and who owes who.

items.title: Provably-fair draws
items.desc: Every draw stores a random seed. Re-run it and get the exact same result — with a 'how the draw worked' explainer for the sceptics.

items.title: Auto prize pot
items.desc: Set the buy-in and KickStake builds a balanced prize structure that reconciles to the cent. Edit any amount — it rebalances live.

items.title: 12 prize categories
items.desc: Winner, runner-up and bronze, plus per-group prizes and comedy categories like Golden Boot, Dirtiest Team and Best Defence.

items.title: Join with a link
items.desc: Players tap your link, type a name, and they're in. No account, no password, nothing to install. Built for the group chat.

items.title: You stay in control
items.desc: Results are auto-suggested from the tournament, but nothing pays out until you approve it. Override any winner, any time.

items.title: Settlement, done
items.desc: Each player's net — winnings minus buy-in — plus who owes who. Money moves off-app; KickStake just keeps the books straight.

prizes.title: More ways to win than just picking the champions
prizes.sub: The default split is drawn from real, battle-tested sweepstakes and always adds up to exactly the pot. Toggle any prize on or off.

items.a: No — it's tracking-only. You record the buy-in and tick off who's paid; the actual payment happens however your group already does it (bank transfer, cash, whatever). At the end KickStake produces a settlement summary so nobody has to do the maths.
Yes. Every draw is generated from a stored random seed and is fully reproducible. Everyone can see every team assignment, plus a 'how the draw worked' explainer. No rigged hats.

items.q: Do players need to sign up?
items.a: No. Organisers sign in with a one-time email code or Google. Players just open the share link and enter a name — no account, no password, no app.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup is pre-loaded — all 48 teams across 12 groups. More tournaments are on the way.
Free to start. Set up a sweepstake, run the draw, and settle up at no cost.

finalCta.title: Ready to kick off?
finalCta.subtitle: Your group is already arguing about who'll win. Give them something to actually play for.
